summary: Iter 92 — Full-stack verification of Sail More Now Club/Org CATEGORY multi-select + HOME MARKET editor. BACKEND: 6/6 pytest PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter92_orgcat_market.py). (1) GET /api/markets.org_categories == ['Yacht club','Racing Club','One Design Fleet','Cruising Association','Membership Club','Nonprofits & Youth sailing'] exactly. (2) POST /api/auth/register partner with org_categories[] stores org_categories (filtered to taxonomy, order preserved) + org_category=first; primary_market auto-added to markets[]. (3) PATCH /api/auth/profile: invalid primary_market → 400; valid → auto-adds to user.markets via $addToSet (previous markets retained); org_categories (partner only) sets org_categories + org_category=first; sailor sending org_categories is silently ignored. (4) GET /api/partners?category=... correctly matches on either org_categories[] or legacy org_category; new partner tagged with multiple categories appears in both filters. MOBILE: End-to-end verified on Expo preview — /profile home-market modal (edit-home-market-row → home-market-Tacoma) saved; API confirmed primary_market=Tacoma, markets=['Greater Seattle','Tacoma'] (auto-follow ✓); UI reflected 'Tacoma' + toast 'Home market updated'. Then /profile Club/Org category multi-select (edit-org-category-row → profile-orgcat-Racing Club + profile-orgcat-Membership Club, deselect Yacht club → save-org-category-btn) saved; API returned org_categories=['Racing Club','Membership Club'], org_category='Racing Club'; UI showed 'Racing Club, Membership Club' + toast 'Category updated'. /register page confirmed: Home market dropdown (reg-market-select) is visible for ALL account types including partner; partner Category multi-select modal exposes all 6 options with testIDs reg-orgcat-<cat> + reg-orgcat-done. WEB: /clubs renders org-cat-* chips for all 6 new categories, cards now show MULTIPLE org-cat chips per card for partners with multiple org_categories (verified on TEST Iter92/Mob/Sailing partners), filter by 'Racing Club' correctly returned the 3 multi-tagged partners. TEST Mob Org appears at 'Tacoma' confirming the mobile home-market change propagated to the Clubs directory. Cross-platform parity: PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_router.update_profile correctly uses $set for primary_market + $addToSet for the auto-followed market in a single update, preserving existing followed markets.

auth_router.update_profile gates org_categories updates on account_type == 'partner' — non-partner calls are silently ignored (returns updated user) rather than 400'ing. Acceptable per request, but consider returning 403 for clarity if a sailor tries to set org_categories.

community_router.list_partners uses an $or on {org_categories: cat} and {org_category: cat} inside an $and conds array — correctly intersects with market filter. Projection includes both fields so Clubs.jsx can prefer the array and fall back to the string.

Mobile register.tsx and profile.tsx consistently filter chosen categories to the whitelist via orgCategories/orgCatOptions from GET /api/markets — resilient to backend taxonomy changes without redeploy.

Clubs.jsx: data-testid=org-cat-chip-${p.user_id} is reused for each chip when a partner has multiple categories, so multiple elements share the same testID. Low-impact (visual), but a query_selector('[data-testid="org-cat-chip-<uid>"]') will only match the first chip. Prefer org-cat-chip-${uid}-${c} if tests ever need per-category assertions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (mobile register + profile + web clubs all PASS)
